items.q: What does Lauren Tan's inverse pyramid say to invest in first?
items.a: **Code and architecture**, then **lints, types and tests**, then verification, with only a **thin layer of prose**.

items.q: Why does tech debt spread faster with agents?
items.a: Agents **copy the patterns in your codebase**, so workarounds spread like **weeds**.

items.q: What should you do each time you correct an agent?
items.a: Turn the correction into a **deterministic check**, not **another AGENTS.md line**.

items.q: Which kind of API should you ban for agents?
items.a: Any API that **needs nuance to use well**, such as **useEffect**.

items.q: How can directory structure carry context?
items.a: Separate **main and renderer folders** with **banned cross-imports**.
They go stale and give agents an **escape hatch to justify quick fixes**, and nothing can **enforce** them.
**Verification artifacts**: videos, screenshots, state charts and proofs.
A **user-facing site map of the app** that gives agents **shared vocabulary**.

items.q: Why fix the inner loop before building a software factory?
items.a: Automating a sloppy loop just **produces more slop**.
